title: A conditional update with no match creates a second Patient
story: The agent updates a patient's phone number with a conditional update on the MRN, but the MRN it searches has a typo. No Patient matches, so the server creates a new Patient from the body and answers 201. The agent reports that it updated the existing patient.
behaviour: FHIR R4 conditional update: with no match and no id in the body, the server creates the resource. Medplum documents the same: if no matching resource is found, one is created from the given data.

sources.says: Conditional update, no matches, no id provided: the server creates the resource.
If it does not find a matching resource, one will be created from the given data.

steps.note: conditional update; the MRN in the search has a typo

agent_reports.summary: Updated the phone number on the patient's existing record.
